recentItems.title: He used to be on the streets. Now he wows crowds with his homemade DJ decks
recentItems.description: Paul Mwangi, or 'Deejay Boboss,' became a sought-after entertainer through a journey that has been anything but ordinary. From struggling through school to living on the streets of Nairobi, he found a lifeline in music, using his self-taught electronic skills to build a wooden DJ deck.

recentItems.description:

recentItems.title: Estonia prepares to close its border crossings with Russia
recentItems.description:
At the border crossing in Estonia's city of Narva, a long line of people braved the cold and rain as they waited for their turn to cross into Russia. Many said they had rushed to the border, hoping to visit family members and relatives in Russia before Estonia closes its border crossings next week.
(AP video by Kostya Manenkov.)

recentItems.title: Mexico seeks U.S. talks over SpaceX use of Mexican airspace
recentItems.description:
Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum said her government was seeking talks with U.S. authorities over SpaceX's rocket launches that use part of Mexico’s airspace following allegations that debris from SpaceX operations had washed ashore in Mexico’s Tamaulipas state. The discussions would address flight permissions, launch frequency and the possibility of relocating the launch site in southern Texas.

recentItems.title: Former French PM Dominique de Villepin to run for president to prevent far-right victory
recentItems.description:
At 73, Dominique de Villepin is making a political comeback. A longtime ally of the late French President Jacque Chirac, the former Prime minister told The Associated Press that his main reason for running in next year's election is to prevent Marine Le Pen from succeeding Emmanuel Macron. recentItems.title: LIVE: First giant panda born in Indonesia turns 1
recentItems.description:
Watch live from Taman Safari Indonesia as Rio, the first giant panda born in the country, celebrates his first birthday. The panda cub was born to Hu Chun and Cai Tao, who arrived from China in 2017 as part of a 10-year conservation partnership.

recentItems.title: UN peacekeepers prepare to leave southern Lebanon with no plan for what's next
recentItems.description:
The U.N. peacekeeping force in southern Lebanon is preparing to end a 50-year mission as tensions between Israel and Hezbollah remain high. The force plans to begin a gradual drawdown of its 7,500 peacekeepers on January 1 unless the U.N. Security Council extends its mandate. (AP video shot by: Malak Harb)

recentItems.title: ‘No future here': Why Senegal’s young people risk their lives to reach Europe
recentItems.description:
On the beach of the coastal fishing town of Kayar, Senegal, almost everyone has been touched by migration. More than 26,000 West Africans, mostly from Senegal and the Gambia, have reached Spain’s Canary Islands this year, according to Spanish authorities. A record 13,000 arrived in November alone — three times the number recorded in the first half of the year. (AP video/Cheikh A.T. Sy)
